name: 三張票券 Hero 與緊湊頁尾修正版
releasePurpose: Restore the hero to a three-ticket carousel without postcards, bring the arrows back, make the left arrow advance and the right arrow go backward, and compact the footer layout so the page height feels tighter.
keyFixes: Hero removes exhibition postcards and returns to a three-ticket composition
Desktop arrows are restored outside the hero frame
Left arrow advances to the next ticket group; right arrow returns to the previous group
Ticket motion now follows a ticket queue: front ticket leaves, middle tickets move forward, and a new ticket enters from the right
Ticket proportions are adjusted to feel more like real admission tickets
Mobile hero keeps the same three-ticket logic with swipe interaction
Footer columns are reorganized and vertical whitespace is reduced
Frontend cache version is bumped to 6.5.0-r7
